https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body: Plateau State has an estimated 11,000 tuberculosis (TB) cases in 2026, with 2,047 patients identified between July and September, according to a state health official. The cases were disclosed by Yohanna Bot, the monitoring and evaluation officer of the Plateau State Tuberculosis and Leprosy Control Programme, at a media advocacy meeting on community-led monitoring of health services in Jos. Mr Bot said the estimated burden was based on a TB prevalence rate of 219 cases per 100,000 people, warning that the disease remained a major public health challenge in the state. “From our quarterly survey, we discovered that between July and September, 2,047 patients were identified and placed on treatment,” he said. He added that the identified patients were receiving treatment at health facilities across the state. Tuberculosis is an infectious disease that primarily affects the lungs and spreads through the air when an infected person coughs, sneezes or speaks. Mr Bot identified malnutrition, advanced age, weakened immunity, overcrowding and HIV infection as factors that could increase the risk of contracting the disease or developing severe illness. He also expressed concern over stigma and misconceptions surrounding TB, saying some residents attributed the disease to spiritual or ritual causes rather than seeking medical attention. According to him, such beliefs discourage people from undergoing early diagnosis and starting treatment promptly. Mr Bot said insecurity and displacement were complicating efforts to detect and manage tuberculosis, particularly in Mangu, Jos South and Barkin Ladi local government areas. He said displacement had led to the establishment of camps for internally displaced persons (IDPs), where overcrowded living conditions could facilitate the spread of the disease. To address the challenge, he said the state programme was prioritising community outreach and active screening in IDP camps and correctional centres to identify people with TB and link them to treatment. Mr Bot said patients who received effective treatment could become much less infectious after starting therapy, although the timing depended on their clinical condition and response to treatment. He, however, raised concerns about shortages of anti-TB medicines, attributing the gaps in availability partly to disruptions in the supply chain and the programme’s dependence on international support, particularly funding from the Global Fund. He called for increased public awareness to address stigma and misconceptions and urged residents with symptoms suggestive of TB to seek medical evaluation at health facilities. Peter Ezekiel, the Plateau State programme officer of the Global Fund AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria Integrated Community-Led Monitoring Project, said Nigeria continued to face a significant burden of tuberculosis, HIV and malaria. He said community-led monitoring was designed to involve residents and other stakeholders in identifying gaps in healthcare delivery and supporting interventions to improve access to essential services. According to him, the approach helps communities identify barriers such as discrimination, stigma and gender-related challenges while advocating better infrastructure and increased domestic funding for healthcare. Mr Ezekiel said the initiative had supported infrastructure rehabilitation, service improvements and stronger community participation in Plateau State. He listed the rehabilitation and re-piping of toilet facilities at the Primary Health Centre in Rantya, Jos South, among the interventions carried out since June. He said community stakeholders had also donated a scanning machine and 10 iron-framed chairs to the Primary Health Centre in Gangare, Jos North, as well as a blood pressure monitoring device to the facility in Dogon Agogo.

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body_zh: 高原州预计2026年将有1.1万例结核病（TB）病例，其中7月至9月期间已发现2047名患者，这是根据该州一名卫生官员的说法。这些病例是由高原州结核病和麻风病控制方案监测与评估官员约汉纳·博特在乔斯举行的关于社区主导卫生服务监测的媒体宣传会议上披露的。博特先生表示，这一预计负担是基于每10万人219例结核病的患病率，他警告说该疾病仍是该州主要的公共卫生挑战。“根据我们的季度调查，我们发现7月至9月期间有2047名患者被发现并开始接受治疗，”他说。他补充说，这些被发现的患者正在全州各地的卫生设施接受治疗。结核病是一种主要影响肺部的传染病，当感染者咳嗽、打喷嚏或说话时会通过空气传播。博特先生指出营养不良、高龄、免疫力减弱、过度拥挤和艾滋病毒感染是可能增加感染该病风险或发展为严重疾病的因素。他还对围绕结核病的污名和误解表示担忧，称一些居民将这种疾病归因于精神或仪式原因，而不是寻求医疗帮助。据他说，这种信念阻碍人们进行早期诊断并及时开始治疗。博特先生说，不安全和流离失所正在使发现和管理结核病的努力复杂化，特别是在曼古、乔斯南和巴尔金拉迪地方政府地区。他说流离失所导致了国内流离失所者（IDPs）营地的建立，那里过度拥挤的生活条件可能促进疾病的传播。为了应对这一挑战，他说该州方案正在优先考虑社区外展和在国内流离失所者营地及惩教中心进行积极筛查，以发现结核病患者并将他们与治疗联系起来。博特先生说，接受有效治疗的患者在开始治疗后感染性会大大降低，尽管时间取决于他们的临床状况和对治疗的反应。然而，他对抗结核病药物的短缺提出了担忧，将可用性方面的差距部分归因于供应链中断以及该方案对国际支持的依赖，特别是全球基金的资金。他呼吁提高公众意识以解决污名和误解，并敦促有结核病症状的居民到卫生设施寻求医疗评估。全球基金艾滋病、结核病和疟疾综合社区主导监测项目高原州方案官员彼得·以西结说，尼日利亚继续面临严重的结核病、艾滋病和疟疾病负担。他说社区主导监测旨在让居民和其他利益相关者参与识别医疗服务提供方面的差距，并支持干预措施以改善基本服务的获取。据他说，这种方法帮助社区识别歧视、污名和性别相关挑战等障碍，同时倡导更好的基础设施和增加国内医疗保健资金。以西结先生说，该倡议支持了高原州的基础设施修复、服务改进和更强的社区参与。他列举了自6月以来开展的干预措施，包括修复和重新铺设乔斯南兰蒂亚初级卫生中心的厕所设施。他说社区利益相关者还向乔斯北甘加雷的初级卫生中心捐赠了一台扫描仪和10把铁框椅子，以及向多贡阿戈戈的设施捐赠了一台血压监测设备。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/bawumia-call.title: Bawumia calls for increased support for Ghana’s garment and apparel industry
https://www.myjoyonline.com/bawumia-call.summary: New Patriotic Party (NPP) flagbearer Dr Mahamudu Bawumia has called for increased support for Ghana’s garment and apparel industry, highlighting its potential to create jobs, strengthen local businesses and contribute to economic growth. Dr Bawumia made the call following a meeting with the Association of Garment and Apparel Manufacturers to discuss challenges affecting the sector and explore measures to improve its competitiveness in international markets.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/bawumia-call.summary_zh: 新爱国党（NPP）旗手马哈穆杜·巴武米亚博士呼吁加强对加纳服装和服饰行业的支持，强调其创造就业、加强本地企业和促进经济增长的潜力。巴武米亚博士是在与服装和服饰制造商协会会晤后发出这一呼吁的，该会晤讨论了影响该行业的挑战，并探讨了提高其在国际市场竞争力的措施。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/bawumia-call.body: New Patriotic Party (NPP) flagbearer Dr Mahamudu Bawumia has called for increased support for Ghana’s garment and apparel industry, highlighting its potential to create jobs, strengthen local businesses and contribute to economic growth. Dr Bawumia made the call following a meeting with the Association of Garment and Apparel Manufacturers to discuss challenges affecting the sector and explore measures to improve its competitiveness in international markets. He noted that Ghana had considerable opportunities to expand garment production but needed stronger support for local manufacturers to compete effectively with producers in other countries. Comparing Ghana’s support for the industry with that provided by countries such as Bangladesh and Benin, Dr Bawumia said more needed to be done to develop the sector. “We agreed that compared to countries such as Bangladesh and Benin, Ghana does not adequately support the garments industry. This must change going forward,” he said in a Facebook post after the meeting. He expressed appreciation to the Association for its contributions, noting that the discussions would inform proposals to address the challenges facing garment and apparel manufacturers. The engagement forms part of Dr Bawumia’s consultations with business groups on issues affecting their operations and possible measures to support their growth. Before meeting the garment manufacturers, he also held discussions with executives and representatives of the Ghana Union of Traders’ Associations (GUTA) on concerns affecting traders across the country. Among the issues raised were high import duties and demurrage charges, the reported increase in Value Added Tax (VAT) for informal sector operators to 20 per cent, limited access to EXIM Bank loans and foreign participation in Ghana’s retail trade. Traders also highlighted the high cost of shop rentals and goodwill payments, which they said posed challenges to running their businesses. Dr Bawumia said the meeting provided an opportunity for GUTA representatives to outline their concerns and propose possible solutions. “We also discussed the importance of transitioning from just importing to producing these goods in Ghana and the incentives to encourage them to do so. It was a very productive meeting and my thanks to GUTA for this meeting,” he said. The engagements focused on challenges facing Ghanaian businesses, with particular attention to supporting local production, improving competitiveness and creating an environment in which manufacturers and traders can expand their operations
https://www.myjoyonline.com/bawumia-call.title_zh: Bawumia呼吁加强对加纳服装和服饰行业的支持
https://www.myjoyonline.com/bawumia-call.body_zh: 新爱国党（NPP）旗手马哈穆杜·巴武米亚博士呼吁加强对加纳服装和服饰行业的支持，强调其创造就业、壮大本地企业并促进经济增长的潜力。巴武米亚博士是在与服装和服饰制造商协会会晤后发出这一呼吁的，会晤讨论了影响该行业的挑战，并探讨了提升其在国际市场竞争力的措施。他指出，加纳拥有扩大服装生产的巨大机会，但需要为本地制造商提供更有力的支持，以便有效与其他国家的生产商竞争。将加纳对该行业的支持与孟加拉国和贝宁等国提供的支持进行比较后，巴武米亚博士表示，需要做更多工作来发展该行业。“我们一致认为，与孟加拉国和贝宁等国相比，加纳对服装行业的支持不够。未来必须改变这种情况，”他在会后的一篇脸书帖子中说。他对该协会的贡献表示感谢，并指出这些讨论将为解决服装和服饰制造商面临的挑战提供提案依据。此次互动是巴武米亚博士与商业团体就影响其运营的问题以及支持其增长的可能措施进行磋商的一部分。在会见服装制造商之前，他还与加纳贸易商协会联盟（GUTA）的执行官和代表就影响全国贸易商的关切进行了讨论。提出的问题包括高额进口关税和滞期费、据报非正式部门经营者的增值税（VAT）增加至20%、获得进出口银行贷款的机会有限以及外国参与加纳零售贸易等问题。贸易商还强调了高昂的店铺租金和商誉付款成本，他们说这些对经营业务构成了挑战。巴武米亚博士表示，这次会议为GUTA代表提供了机会来概述他们的关切并提出可能的解决方案。“我们还讨论了从单纯进口转向在加纳生产这些商品的重要性，以及鼓励他们这样做的激励措施。这是一次非常富有成效的会议，我感谢GUTA举行这次会议，”他说。这些互动聚焦于加纳企业面临的挑战，特别关注支持本地生产、提高竞争力以及创造一个能让制造商和贸易商扩大业务的环境。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/u.title: Uphold the Four Principles to Promote Lasting Peace and Stability in Africa
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/u.summary: These principles provide clear guidance for tackling hotspot issues in Africa and exploring a path toward lasting peace and stability. China supports regional countries in bridging differences and building synergy through dialogue and consultation, jointly strengthening the barriers of regional peace and security, and creating a favorable environment for Africa’s stability and development. Accelerating industrialization is both an urgent developmental need and a fundamental guarantee of lasting peace and stability.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/u.summary_zh: 这些原则为解决非洲热点问题和探索持久和平与稳定之路提供了明确指导。中国支持地区国家通过对话和协商弥合分歧、凝聚合力，共同筑牢地区和平与安全的屏障，为非洲稳定与发展创造有利环境。加快工业化既是紧迫的发展需求，也是持久和平与稳定的根本保障。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/u.body: The world is undergoing accelerated changes unseen in a century, with profound shifts in the international balance of power. Africa’s peace and development face both new opportunities and challenges. On the one hand, African countries’ sense of independence continues to grow, and their desire for unity, self-reliance and improved livelihoods is stronger than ever. On the other hand, hotspot issues on the continent persist and recur, deeply affecting the people of the region. These issues have complex causes. Resolving them and settling disputes requires building consensus and pooling collective strength. Recently, when meeting with President Faure Gnassingbé of Togo, Chinese President Xi Jinping put forward four principles for constructive participation by all parties in resolving African hotspot issues: upholding African leadership, safeguarding equity and justice, ceasing hostilities and building peace as well as addressing both symptoms and root causes. These principles provide clear guidance for tackling hotspot issues in Africa and exploring a path toward lasting peace and stability. They fully demonstrate China’s understanding of and support for Africa’s efforts to carry forward Pan-Africanism, independently safeguard peace and security, and redress historical injustices. As Chinese Ambassador to Nigeria, I would like to share my understanding of these four important principles. First, we must uphold African leadership. President Xi Jinping pointed out that the African people are the true masters of the continent and should therefore play a central role in regional affairs. China supports African countries, the African Union and sub-regional organizations in upholding self-confidence and self-reliance, pursuing unity and development, and drawing on African traditions and wisdom to effectively address the various challenges facing the continent. History has repeatedly shown that externally imposed “prescriptions” often fail to suit local conditions. Only by respecting Africa’s independent choices and listening to African voices can lasting and effective solutions be found. China adheres to the principle of sincerity, real results, amity, and good faith in its relations with Africa. It never interferes in Africa’s internal affairs, never imposes its will on others, and always respects the principal role of African countries and peoples. China firmly practices the approach of “African solutions to African problems.” As Africa’s most populous country and an important member of ECOWAS, Nigeria has long worked to maintain stability in West Africa and has demonstrated the responsibility of a major country in mediating regional disputes, combating extremism, and building regional consensus. China highly appreciates these efforts and will, as always, support ECOWAS and other sub-regional organizations in playing an important role in mediation and good offices. Second, we must safeguard equity and justice. President Xi Jinping stressed that parties involved should observe the purposes and principles of the UN Charter, respect the sovereignty and territorial integrity of the countries concerned, practice true multilateralism, uphold a vision of common, comprehensive, cooperative and sustainable security, take into account the legitimate concerns of all sides, and seek fair and reasonable solutions. Equity and justice are basic norms of international relations and a shared aspiration of African countries. Applying double standards in regional affairs, frequently interfering in internal affairs, or imposing external will only create new instability and ultimately undermine lasting peace. Safeguarding territorial integrity and sovereignty and combating terrorism are matters within the sovereign rights of African countries. The international community should respect the independent choices of African nations and provide constructive support and assistance on the premise of respecting the countries concerned.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/u.title_zh: 坚持四项原则以促进非洲持久和平与稳定
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/u.body_zh: 世界正在经历百年未有之大变局，国际力量对比深刻调整。非洲和平与发展既面临新的机遇，也面临新的挑战。一方面，非洲国家独立自主意识持续增强，团结自强、改善民生的愿望比以往任何时候都更加强烈。另一方面，非洲大陆热点问题持续存在、反复出现，深刻影响地区人民。这些问题成因复杂，化解矛盾、解决争端需要凝聚共识、汇聚合力。近日，中国国家主席习近平在会见多哥总统福雷·纳辛贝时，就各方建设性参与解决非洲热点问题提出四点原则：坚持非洲主导、维护公平正义、停火止战促和、标本兼治。这些原则为应对非洲热点问题、探索长治久安之道提供了清晰指引，充分体现了中国对非洲弘扬泛非主义、自主维护和平安全、纠正历史不公的理解与支持。作为中国驻尼日利亚大使，我想分享对这四项重要原则的理解。第一，坚持非洲主导。习近平主席指出，非洲人民才是非洲大陆的主人，应该在地区事务中发挥中心作用。中国支持非洲国家、非洲联盟和次区域组织坚持自信自立、团结发展，汲取非洲传统智慧，有效应对非洲大陆面临的各种挑战。历史反复证明，外部强加的“药方”往往水土不服。只有尊重非洲的自主选择、倾听非洲的声音，才能找到持久有效的解决之道。中国对非坚持真诚友好、平等相待，从不干涉非洲内政，从不把自己的意志强加于人，始终尊重非洲国家和人民的主导地位。中国坚定践行“非洲问题非洲解决”的理念。作为非洲人口最多的国家以及西非国家经济共同体的重要成员，尼日利亚长期致力于维护西非稳定，在调解地区争端、打击极端主义、凝聚地区共识等方面展现了大国担当。中国高度赞赏这些努力，并将一如既往支持西非国家经济共同体等次区域组织在调解斡旋中发挥重要作用。第二，维护公平正义。习近平主席强调，有关各方应恪守联合国宪章宗旨和原则，尊重当事国主权和领土完整，践行真正的多边主义，坚持共同、综合、合作、可持续的安全观，照顾各方合理关切，寻求公平合理的解决方案。公平正义是国际关系基本准则，也是非洲国家的共同诉求。在地区事务中搞双重标准、频繁干涉内政、强加外部意志，只会制造新的不稳定，最终损害持久和平。维护领土完整和主权、打击恐怖主义属于非洲国家的主权权利。国际社会应尊重非洲国家的自主选择，在尊重当事国前提下提供建设性支持和帮助。

The gathering was also aimed at mobilising grassroots backing for the leaders as political activities gradually build towards the 2027 elections. Dankabo described the turnout as an encouraging sign for the alliance, saying its members were determined to continue engaging residents and strengthening support across the area. He said the group would sustain its mobilisation activities until it achieved its objectives. The convener also said the alliance would remain committed to the trust placed in its members by supporters. Dankabo said the gathering had given the alliance confidence about the electoral prospects of Tinubu, Yusuf and Barau. He also expressed confidence that residents of Kabo would support the leaders at the polls. The statements reflect the alliance convener’s expectations and political position ahead of the elections. For the Tinubu Abba Barau Alliance, the Kabo gathering represents an effort to demonstrate local support for the three leaders. However, the size of the gathering alone does not establish the level of electoral support the candidates will receive across Kabo or Kano State. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/f.title: Food Security: Abiodun Deepens Ogun’s Agricultural Transformation Drive

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/f.summary_zh: 由于尼日利亚正在努力应对食品可负担性和不断上升的农业生产成本，奥贡州在州长达波·阿比奥敦领导下，正在加强努力，通过针对农民的扶持、机械化、数字创新以及整个农业价值链的投资来改善粮食安全。在主题为“今天创新，明天滋养”的世界粮食日活动上，阿比奥敦宣布为2000名水稻种植者和8000名木薯种植者提供一揽子农业投入物。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/f.body: With support for 10,000 farmers, new mechanisation equipment, digital technology and investments in agro-processing, Governor Dapo Abiodun is pursuing a multi-pronged strategy to boost food production, reduce post-harvest losses and improve farmers’ livelihoods. As Nigeria grapples with food affordability and rising agricultural production costs, Ogun State, under Governor Dapo Abiodun, is strengthening efforts to improve food security through targeted support for farmers, mechanisation, digital innovation and investments across the agricultural value chain. The latest intervention, unveiled at the 2026 World Food Day celebration in Abeokuta, provides a clear indication of this approach. It targets 10,000 rice and cassava farmers with subsidised farm inputs, alongside the distribution of 10 tractors, other agricultural equipment and 1,200 Android phones equipped with applications for weather information, market prices and best agricultural practices. The initiative reflects an understanding that improving food security requires more than increasing the volume of crops planted. It also demands affordable inputs, timely information, efficient production systems, better storage, processing facilities and reliable access to markets. For farmers, the cost of fertilisers, herbicides, improved planting materials and machinery can determine whether a farming season produces a profit or deepens existing financial difficulties. By intervening in these areas, the Ogun State Government is seeking to reduce some of the barriers confronting farmers while improving their capacity to respond to market demands. At the World Food Day event, themed “Innovate Today, Nourish Tomorrow,” Abiodun announced a package of agricultural inputs for 2,000 rice farmers and 8,000 cassava farmers. Under the arrangement, each beneficiary will receive two bags of fertiliser and one bag of urea. Cassava farmers will also receive 25 bundles of cassava stems each, while the government will provide 10 litres of herbicides to each beneficiary cassava farmer and three litres to each beneficiary rice farmer. According to the state government, beneficiaries will contribute 30 per cent of the cost of the inputs, depending on the category, while the government will cover the remaining 70 per cent through its partnership with the International Fund for Agricultural Development. The cost-sharing arrangement is intended to make essential farm inputs more accessible while supporting farmers to increase production. Its ultimate impact will depend on the timely distribution of the inputs, effective monitoring and the extent to which the intervention translates into higher yields and better incomes. For a state with considerable agricultural potential and proximity to major consumer markets, such interventions carry economic significance beyond the farm. Increased production can support food processing, transportation, wholesale and retail trade, while creating employment opportunities for people who may not be directly engaged in cultivation. One of the longstanding challenges of Nigerian agriculture is the limited access of smallholder farmers to modern equipment. Dependence on manual labour can restrict the size of cultivated land, delay planting and harvesting, and increase production costs. The distribution of 10 tractors and other agricultural equipment to farm settlements and farmers’ associations is part of Ogun State’s response to this challenge. Abiodun disclosed that his administration had also procured 39 tractors, four self-propelled harvesters and other agricultural equipment to support mechanisation across the sector. The importance of mechanisation lies not merely in the number of machines acquired but in the additional land farmers can cultivate, the time saved during critical farming operations and the reduction in losses caused by delays in planting and harvesting.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/f.title_zh: 粮食安全：Abiodun深化奥贡州的农业转型驱动
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/f.body_zh: 在支持10,000名农民、新的机械化设备、数字技术和农产品加工投资的情况下，州长达波·阿比奥顿正在推行一项多管齐下的战略，以提高粮食产量、减少收获后损失并改善农民的生计。随着尼日利亚努力应对食品可负担性和不断上升的农业生产成本，奥贡州在州长达波·阿比奥顿的领导下，正在通过针对农民的定向支持、机械化、数字创新以及整个农业价值链的投资来加强改善粮食安全的努力。在阿贝奥库塔举行的2026年世界粮食日庆祝活动上公布的最新干预措施清楚表明了这种做法。它针对10,000名水稻和木薯农民提供补贴的农场投入，同时分发10台拖拉机、其他农业设备和1,200部装有天气信息、市场价格和最佳农业实践应用程序的安卓手机。该举措反映出这样一种认识，即改善粮食安全需要的不仅仅是增加种植作物的数量。它还需要负担得起的投入、及时的信息、高效的生产系统、更好的储存、加工设施以及可靠的市场准入。对于农民来说，化肥、除草剂、改良种植材料和机械的成本可能决定一个耕作季节是产生利润还是加深现有的财务困难。通过在这些领域进行干预，奥贡州政府正在寻求减少农民面临的一些障碍，同时提高他们响应市场需求的能力。在主题为“今天创新，明天滋养”的世界粮食日活动上，阿比奥顿宣布为2,000名水稻农民和8,000名木薯农民提供一揽子农业投入。根据该安排，每名受益者将获得两袋化肥和一袋尿素。每名木薯农民还将获得25捆木薯茎，而政府将为每名受益木薯农民提供10升除草剂，为每名受益水稻农民提供3升除草剂。据州政府称，受益者将根据类别支付投入成本的30%，而政府将通过与国际农业发展基金的伙伴关系承担剩余的70%。这种成本分担安排旨在使基本农场投入更容易获得，同时支持农民增加生产。其最终影响将取决于投入的及时分发、有效监测以及干预措施在多大程度上转化为更高的产量和更好的收入。对于一个具有相当大农业潜力且靠近主要消费市场的州来说，此类干预措施具有超出农场的经济意义。增加的生产可以支持食品加工、运输、批发和零售贸易，同时为可能不直接从事种植的人创造就业机会。尼日利亚农业长期面临的挑战之一是小农对现代设备的获取有限。依赖手工劳动会限制耕地面积、延误种植和收获，并增加生产成本。向农场定居点和农民协会分发10台拖拉机和其他农业设备是奥贡州应对这一挑战的一部分。阿比奥顿透露，他的政府还采购了39台拖拉机、四台自走式收割机和其他农业设备，以支持整个行业的机械化。机械化的重要性不仅在于所购机器的数量，而在于农民可以额外耕种的土地、在关键耕作操作期间节省的时间以及因种植和收获延误造成的损失减少。

https://leadership.ng/2027-apc-declares-.summary_zh: 全体进步大会（APC）已宣布博拉·蒂努布总统2027年连任“不可谈判”，同时承诺确保在全国范围内开展和平与安全的竞选活动。“我最喜欢的一句来自军方的声明是，这个国家的统一是不可谈判的，而现在今天我听到我们的一些将军说，这次选举的胜利是不可谈判的，”他说。
https://leadership.ng/2027-apc-declares-.body: The All Progressives Congress (APC) has declared President Bola Tinubu’s re-election in 2027 “non-negotiable”, while pledging to ensure peaceful and secure campaigns across the country. The ruling party reaffirmed the position on Sunday in Abuja during the inauguration of national and sub-national structures of the Directorate of Security and Intelligence of the APC Presidential Campaign Council. APC National Chairman, Prof. Nentawe Yilwatda, who was represented by the party’s Deputy National Secretary, Prof. Abdulkarim Abubakar Kana (SAN), said the directorate had moved faster than other arms of the campaign council. Kana urged politicians to learn from the military, particularly its discipline, organisation and speed of execution, stressing the importance of structure in political campaigns. “We have a lot to learn from the military – the discipline, the alacrity, the organisation… Even as we organise our campaigns, regimentation is very important. “One of my favourite statements from the military is that the unity of this country is non-negotiable, and now today I heard some of our generals saying that victory in this election is non-negotiable,” he said. He charged the directorate to ensure adequate security before, during and after campaign activities, including securing venues and access roads. “Before we leave, you must clear the path; you must confirm to us that the venue is safe. When we are there, you must ensure that we are safe and protected. When we leave, you must ensure that the paths and roads are secure. Your committee is the one that will be there ahead of us and remain there even after we leave,” he said. Also speaking, the Minister of Defence and First Secretary of the directorate, General Christopher Musa, expressed confidence in Tinubu’s re-election, saying the immediate priority was to establish a secure environment for the campaign. “The return of Mr President is not an issue that we should even start worrying about, because God’s willing, he is coming back. The task before us now is to provide the enabling environment for it to happen. The issue of security is paramount and is key to our success. “We must do everything possible to make sure that Nigeria is safe and secure. And our campaigns are peaceful and safe, because I think that is the most critical aspect of what we do,” he said. The Director of Intelligence and Security of the council, Major General Sarkin Yaki Bello (retd.), who inaugurated the structures, urged members to discharge their responsibilities within the confines of the law. “Our duty is to protect Mr President and the people, and not to threaten them, to preserve order, not to create fear, and to support a peaceful democratic process,” he said. The Special Adviser to the President on Homeland Security, Major General Adeyinka A. Famadewa (retd.), said the directorate was expected to ensure an orderly electoral process through effective security arrangements. “Without security, what you have is chaos, and chaos is not what we need at this time. And our job is to make the process safe and secure,” he said. Meanwhile, former Chief of Defence Staff and Chairman of Operations and Field Coordination of the directorate, General Abayomi Gabriel Olonisakin (retd.), said preparations for the campaign would begin immediately, with activities expected to extend across the 36 states. “The job is just starting. By this weekend, the flag-off will start, and we are expected to go to the 36 states,” he said. Speaking on behalf of the inaugurated officers, the directorate’s Southwest coordinator, Lt. Gen. Lamidi Adeosun (retd.), said they understood the need to translate their appointments into measurable results. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/2027-apc-declares-.title_zh: 2027年：APC宣布蒂努布的连任不可谈判，承诺和平竞选
https://leadership.ng/2027-apc-declares-.body_zh: 全进步大会党（APC）已宣布博拉·蒂努布总统2027年连任“不可谈判”，同时承诺确保全国范围内的竞选活动和平安全。该执政党于周日在阿布贾重申了这一立场，当时正值APC总统竞选委员会安全与情报局国家和地方分支机构就职典礼。APC全国主席恩塔韦·伊尔瓦特达教授由该党副全国书记阿卜杜勒卡里姆·阿布巴卡尔·卡纳教授（SAN）代表出席，他表示该局的行动速度快于竞选委员会的其他部门。卡纳敦促政治家向军队学习，特别是其纪律、组织性和执行速度，并强调结构在政治竞选中的重要性。“我们有很多东西要向军队学习——纪律、敏捷、组织……即使在我们组织竞选活动时，严格的组织纪律也非常重要。“我最喜欢的一句军队名言是，这个国家的统一是不可谈判的，而今天我听到我们的一些将军说，这次选举的胜利是不可谈判的，”他说。他要求该局确保在竞选活动之前、期间和之后提供充分的安全保障，包括保护场地和进出道路。“在我们离开之前，你们必须清理道路；你们必须向我们确认场地是安全的。当我们在那里时，你们必须确保我们是安全的并受到保护。当我们离开时，你们必须确保道路和路径是安全的。你们的委员会将是我们之前到达并在我们离开后仍留在那里的人，”他说。此外，国防部长兼该局第一书记克里斯托弗·穆萨将军在发言中对蒂努布的连任表示信心，称当前的首要任务是建立一个安全的竞选环境。“总统先生的回归不是我们甚至应该开始担心的问题，因为如果上帝愿意，他会回来的。我们现在的任务是为此创造有利的环境。安全问题是首要的，是我们成功的关键。“我们必须尽一切可能确保尼日利亚是安全的。我们必须确保我们的竞选活动是和平和安全的，因为我认为这是我们所做的最关键方面，”他说。该委员会情报与安全主任萨尔金·亚基·贝洛少将（退役）主持了这些机构的就职典礼，他敦促成员在法律范围内履行职责。“我们的职责是保护总统先生和人民，而不是威胁他们，是维护秩序，而不是制造恐惧，并支持和平的民主进程，”他说。总统国土安全特别顾问阿德因卡·A·法马德瓦少将（退役）表示，该局预计将通过有效的安全安排确保有序的选举进程。“没有安全，你所拥有的就是混乱，而混乱不是我们此时需要的。我们的工作就是让这个过程安全可靠，”他说。与此同时，前国防参谋长兼该局行动与实地协调主席阿巴约米·加布里埃尔·奥洛尼萨金将军（退役）表示，竞选准备工作将立即开始，活动预计将扩展到36个州。“工作才刚刚开始。本周末，启动仪式将开始，我们预计将前往36个州，”他说。代表就职官员发言的该局西南协调员拉米迪·阿德奥桑中将（退役）表示，他们理解需要将他们的任命转化为可衡量的成果。我们拥有优势。获取实时报道、突发独家新闻和独家角度，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于陈旧的新闻。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/kofi-asare-c.title: Kofi Asare calls for sanctions against officials who failed to act on Obuasi SHTS abuse allegations
https://www.myjoyonline.com/kofi-asare-c.summary: The Executive Director of Africa Education Watch, Kofi Asare, has called for an assessment of the conduct of public officials who may have failed to act on reports of alleged sexual abuse at Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS), saying accountability must extend beyond the headmaster facing criminal charges.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/kofi-asare-c.summary_zh: 非洲教育观察执行主任科菲·阿萨雷呼吁对可能未对奥布阿西高级技术学校（SHTS）涉嫌性虐待报告采取行动的公职人员行为进行评估，并表示问责必须扩大到面临刑事指控的校长之外。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/kofi-asare-c.body: The Executive Director of Africa Education Watch, Kofi Asare, has called for an assessment of the conduct of public officials who may have failed to act on reports of alleged sexual abuse at Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS), saying accountability must extend beyond the headmaster facing criminal charges. He said officials at the school, municipal level and other relevant institutions should be investigated to establish what they knew about the allegations, what action they took and whether they followed the procedures governing their responsibilities. Speaking on Joy FM’s Super Morning Show on Monday, October 19, during a discussion on the sexual assault allegations at Obuasi SHTS, Mr Asare said the case required a wider examination of possible institutional failures. He argued that punishing the individual accused would not be enough if other officials had failed to carry out their duties despite being aware of the allegations. “We all know that a lot of officials were involved, either directly or indirectly, by actions or their inactions in this issue,” he said. Mr Asare called for an assessment of the conduct of officials at different levels, including those within the school, the municipal administration and other institutions that may have received reports of the alleged abuse. He said the review should establish what each official knew, what steps were taken in response, and whether those actions complied with the relevant standard operating procedures (SOPs). “It is important that we do an assessment of the actions and omissions at school level, municipal level and all relevant officials who became aware of these allegations, and then the actions they took, and reconcile the actions they took in line with the GES SOPs or the institutions that they were in,” he said. The Africa Education Watch executive director said the review should not be limited to establishing whether officials knew about the allegations. It should also determine whether they fulfilled their responsibilities under the rules governing their offices. He said the procedures applicable to officials in different institutions, including municipal chief executives and police officers, should be examined to establish whether they acted appropriately when confronted with safeguarding concerns. “If the person was an MCE, what are the SOPs when it comes to safeguarding? If the person was a police commander or a police officer, what are the SOPs when it comes to safeguarding?” he asked. Mr Asare said officials found to have failed to act in accordance with their responsibilities should face administrative sanctions. He argued that public officials had a duty to protect people under their care and respond appropriately to allegations of abuse, particularly where children were involved. The proposed assessment, he said, would help establish responsibility for any failures and ensure that the appropriate consequences followed. “This is how we exact institutional accountability beyond the headmaster who is now facing criminal charges,” he said. Mr Asare also called on JoyNews to follow up on a police statement concerning a foetus reportedly exhumed during investigations linked to disturbances at the school. He said the district police commander had indicated in an interview that officers had found and exhumed the foetus and would investigate the matter further. However, he said there had been no subsequent public update explaining where it came from or what investigators had established. “I would like JoyNews to follow up on the day the police went to the school, on the day of the rioting. I heard the district commander's interview. He said that they had found the foetus. They had exhumed it, and then they were going to investigate and come back to us,” he said. “We haven't heard anything about the foetus. Where did the foetus come from? We have not heard about anything in relation to the foetus so far,” he added.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/kofi-asare-c.title_zh: Kofi Asare呼吁对未能对奥布阿西SHTS虐待指控采取行动的官员实施制裁
https://www.myjoyonline.com/kofi-asare-c.body_zh: 非洲教育观察执行主任科菲·阿萨雷呼吁对可能未对奥布阿西高级技术学校（SHTS）涉嫌性虐待报告采取行动的公职人员行为进行评估，并表示问责必须超出面临刑事指控的校长范围。他说，学校、市政层面和其他相关机构官员应接受调查，以确定他们对这些指控了解多少、采取了什么行动以及是否遵循了管理其职责的程序。10月19日星期一，在Joy FM《超级晨间秀》上讨论奥布阿西SHTS性侵指控时，阿萨雷先生表示，此案需要更广泛地审查可能存在的机构失职。他认为，如果其他官员在知晓指控的情况下未能履行职责，那么仅惩罚被指控的个人是不够的。“我们都知道很多官员以直接或间接方式，通过作为或不作为卷入了这一问题，”他说。阿萨雷先生呼吁对不同层级官员的行为进行评估，包括学校内部、市政管理部门以及可能收到涉嫌虐待报告的其他机构。他说，审查应确定每位官员了解什么、采取了哪些应对步骤，以及这些行动是否符合相关标准操作程序（SOPs）。“重要的是我们对学校层面、市政层面以及所有知晓这些指控的相关官员的作为和不作为进行评估，然后是他们采取的行动，并将他们采取的行动与GES SOPs或他们所在机构的规定进行对照，”他说。非洲教育观察执行主任表示，审查不应仅限于确定官员是否知晓指控。它还应确定他们是否履行了其职位规则规定的职责。他说，应审查适用于不同机构官员的程序，包括市政首席执行官和警察，以确定他们在面对保护担忧时是否采取了适当行动。“如果此人是市政首席执行官，那么在保护方面有哪些SOPs？如果此人是警察指挥官或警察，那么在保护方面有哪些SOPs？”他问道。阿萨雷先生表示，被发现未按照职责行事的官员应面临行政处罚。他认为，公职人员有责任保护其照顾下的人，并对虐待指控作出适当回应，尤其是在涉及儿童的情况下。他说，拟议的评估将有助于确定任何失职的责任，并确保采取适当的后果。“这就是我们在面临刑事指控的校长之外如何实现机构问责的方式，”他说。阿萨雷先生还呼吁JoyNews跟进警方关于据报在与学校骚乱相关的调查中挖掘出的胎儿的声明。他说，地区警察指挥官在一次采访中表示，警官们已经发现并挖掘出胎儿，并将进一步调查此事。然而，他说，此后没有公开更新解释它来自哪里或调查人员得出了什么结论。“我希望JoyNews跟进警察去学校的那一天，也就是骚乱发生的那一天。我听到了地区指挥官的采访。他说他们发现了胎儿。他们挖掘了它，然后他们将进行调查并回来告诉我们，”他说。“我们没有听到关于胎儿的任何消息。胎儿是从哪里来的？到目前为止我们没有听到与胎儿有关的任何消息，”他补充道。

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.title: Benue Catholic school relocates students over security concerns

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body: St Winifred Girls Secondary School, Ihugh, in Benue State, has temporarily relocated its students to four Catholic schools across the state following repeated fires at its hostels and concerns over their safety. In a circular dated 17 October, the school’s management said the relocation followed consultations with the Bishop of the Catholic Diocese of Gboko and the Director of Catholic Education Services. The students are expected to resume at their new schools on 23 October. Under the arrangement, Basic 7 and Senior Secondary School (SSS) 2 students will attend Queen of the Rosary Secondary School, Gboko, while Basic 8 and 9 students will move to St Mary Girls’ Secondary School, Adikpo. SSS 1 students will attend Our Lady of Apostles Girls’ Secondary School, Vandeikya, while SSS 3 students will be placed at Notre Dame Secondary School, Mkar. The school said the arrangement was temporary, pending further decisions by the Church on its future, particularly in view of security concerns surrounding its location. “We wish to reassure all parents/guardians that this arrangement is temporary,” the circular said. Some teaching and non-teaching staff have also been assigned to the receiving schools to support teaching and learning and guide the students at their temporary locations. The management apologised to parents and students for the disruption, saying it would establish communication channels to keep families informed. The relocation follows repeated fires at the student hostels, which the Catholic Diocese of Gboko cited in its decision to close Catholic institutions in Ihugh. In a pastoral letter and decree dated 12 October, the diocese announced the indefinite closure of St Winifred Girls Secondary School, St Winifred Nursery and Primary School, St Thomas Hospital and Salus Mudi Care Centre, as well as St Winifred Parish. The decree was signed by the Bishop of Gboko, William Avenya, and the diocesan chancellor, Marcellinus Wende. The diocese said the school’s student hostels were burnt on 28 October 2025, 10 May 2026, 15 May 2026 and 11 October 2026. It also cited repeated burglaries at St Winifred Parish and criminal incidents at St Thomas Hospital, describing the incidents as part of a pattern of hostility and destruction directed at Church-owned properties. The diocese said it had engaged community leaders, traditional rulers and security authorities in efforts to resolve the situation but had not obtained lasting assurances of safety. “The Church cannot, in conscience, continue to expose her Priests, Consecrated Persons, Teachers, Medical personnel, Students and Patients to danger,” the pastoral letter said. PREMIUM TIMES earlier reported that the diocese ordered the closure of the institutions and the withdrawal of its pastoral agents from Ihugh, citing repeated attacks, arson and the absence of adequate security guarantees. In a separate letter addressed to students and their parents, the school’s principal, Isaac Shalegh, apologised for the repeated incidents and the disruption to the students’ education. He said he had repeatedly assured the students that conditions would improve after earlier fires but was devastated when another incident occurred. According to the principal, community stakeholders had previously assured the school that the incidents would not recur and that damaged buildings would be reconstructed within three months, ahead of the students’ return in September 2026. He said the students returned to find that the assurances had not been fulfilled as expected. The principal also recounted an incident on Friday, 9 October, when students reportedly noticed suspicious activity suggesting an attempt to set another hostel building on fire. He said he contacted relevant authorities before another fire incident occurred on Sunday, 11 October.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.title_zh: 贝努埃天主教学校因安全问题搬迁学生
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body_zh: 位于贝努埃州的伊胡格圣温妮弗雷德女子中学在宿舍多次发生火灾并对学生安全表示担忧后，已临时将其学生转移到该州四所天主教学校。在10月17日的一份通告中，学校管理层表示，此次搬迁是在与 Gboko 天主教教区主教和天主教教育服务主任协商后进行的。学生预计将于10月23日在新学校复课。根据安排，基础7年级和高中二年级（SSS 2）学生将就读 Gboko 的玫瑰后中学，而基础8年级和9年级学生将转到 Adikpo 的圣玛丽女子中学。高中一年级（SSS 1）学生将就读 Vandeikya 的圣使徒圣母女子中学，而高中三年级（SSS 3）学生将被安排在 Mkar 的圣母中学。学校表示，该安排是临时的，取决于教会对其未来的进一步决定，特别是考虑到其所在位置周围的安全问题。“我们希望向所有家长/监护人保证，此安排是临时的，”通告说。部分教学和非教学人员也被派往接收学校，以支持教学工作并在临时地点指导学生。管理层向家长和学生道歉，称此举造成不便，并表示将建立沟通渠道，让家属随时了解情况。此次搬迁是在学生宿舍多次发生火灾之后进行的，Gboko 天主教教区在其关闭伊胡格天主教机构的决定中提到了这些火灾。在10月12日的一封牧函和法令中，该教区宣布无限期关闭圣温妮弗雷德女子中学、圣温妮弗雷德幼儿园和小学、圣托马斯医院、Salus Mudi 护理中心以及圣温妮弗雷德堂区。该法令由 Gboko 主教 William Avenya 和教区秘书长 Marcellinus Wende 签署。教区表示，学校的学生宿舍分别于2025年10月28日、2026年5月10日、2026年5月15日和2026年10月11日被焚毁。它还提到了圣温妮弗雷德堂区反复发生的盗窃事件以及圣托马斯医院的犯罪事件，将这些事件描述为针对教会财产的敌对和破坏模式的一部分。教区表示，它曾与社区领袖、传统统治者和安全当局接触以努力解决这一情况，但未能获得持久的安全保证。“教会不能在良心上继续让她的神父、献身者、教师、医务人员、学生和患者面临危险，”牧函说。PREMIUM TIMES 此前报道称，该教区下令关闭这些机构并从伊胡格撤回其牧灵人员，理由是反复发生的袭击、纵火以及缺乏足够的安全保障。在另一封写给学生及其家长的信中，学校校长 Isaac Shalegh 为反复发生的事件以及对学生教育的干扰表示歉意。他说，他曾多次向学生保证，在早些时候的火灾后情况会有所改善，但当另一起事件发生时，他感到非常震惊。据校长说，社区利益相关者此前曾向学校保证，此类事件不会再次发生，受损建筑将在三个月内重建，以便学生在2026年9月返校。他说，学生返校后发现这些保证并未如预期那样兑现。校长还讲述了10月9日星期五发生的一起事件，当时学生据报注意到可疑活动，表明有人试图再次纵火焚烧另一栋宿舍楼。他说，他在另一起火灾于10月11日星期日发生之前联系了有关当局。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/obuasi-shts-.body: Executive Director of the ARK Foundation, Angela Dwamena-Aboagye, has expressed concern over repeated reports of sexual abuse in Ghanaian secondary schools, saying the failure to address such cases points to serious weaknesses in the country's systems for protecting children. She has called for a thorough investigation into the sexual assault allegations involving the headmaster of Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS), insisting that everyone who may have helped to conceal the alleged abuse must be identified and held accountable. Speaking on Joy FM's Super Morning Show on Monday, October 19, during a discussion on the Obuasi SHTS case, Ms Dwamena-Aboagye questioned how sexual abuse in schools had been allowed to persist despite previous reports and investigations. When asked how the country had allowed abuse in secondary schools to become almost normalised, she said the repeated cases should prompt serious questions about the effectiveness of existing child protection systems. “It shouldn't be a shock, but if you keep hearing these things happening over and over again, you know that we are operating in a system that has no system or a very, very broken system,” she said. She said that the allegations were not an isolated incident, pointing to previous media investigations and reports of abuse involving female students in other secondary schools. “Joy FM, you have done other investigations; other reports came out of females in other secondary schools and what had happened. What has happened to all those cases?” she asked. According to her, the recurrence of such cases raises concerns about whether the authorities have learnt from previous incidents and taken effective steps to prevent similar abuses. Ms Dwamena-Aboagye said the situation reflected a wider societal problem in which the experiences of children, particularly girls who report sexual abuse, were often overlooked. She described this as the invisibility of sexual violence in society and the justice system, arguing that the concerns of children were frequently ignored by adults who should be protecting them. “It just tells me something about our mindset. I won't even say culture or mindset. It will be part of modernity and culture combined,” she said. She added that the failure to take allegations seriously could leave victims without justice and allow abuse to continue. The ARK Foundation executive director, however, stressed that the accused must be presumed innocent until proven guilty. “This is a case where, if the allegations are proved, and yes, we all know that a person is presumed innocent until proven guilty and we need to remind ourselves of that,” she said. Despite this legal principle, she urged the authorities to treat the allegations with the seriousness they deserved and investigate the circumstances surrounding the case. She said the country needed to move beyond expressions of concern and take concrete steps to ensure that sexual abuse was not tolerated in schools. Ms Dwamena-Aboagye called for everyone who may have enabled or concealed the alleged abuse to be identified and sanctioned, saying accountability should extend beyond the person accused. “All colluders must be identified and sanctioned at every level,” she said. She said that ending impunity was essential to preventing further cases of sexual violence and ensuring that those responsible could not rely on their positions or connections to escape accountability. “The first thing is that impunity must end. We must let people understand you can't bring our mindset of invisibility of sexual violence into a case that is happening live. We need to act,” she said. The ARK Foundation executive director said the Department of Social Welfare should have identified the alleged victims, including those who might have returned to their home communities, and ensured they received psychosocial support.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/obuasi-shts-.title_zh: 奥布阿西SHTS案件：我们正在运行一个‘非常破败’的系统——Angela Dwamena-Aboagye
https://www.myjoyonline.com/obuasi-shts-.body_zh: ARK基金会执行主任安吉拉·德瓦梅娜-阿博阿吉对加纳中学反复出现的性虐待报告表示担忧，她说未能处理此类案件表明该国保护儿童的系统存在严重缺陷。她呼吁对涉及奥布阿西高级技术学校（SHTS）校长性侵指控进行彻底调查，坚持认为任何可能帮助隐瞒所谓虐待行为的人都必须被查明并追究责任。10月19日星期一，在Joy FM的Super Morning Show上讨论奥布阿西SHTS案件时，德瓦梅娜-阿博阿吉女士质疑，尽管之前有报告和调查，为什么学校性虐待现象仍被允许持续存在。当被问及该国如何允许中学虐待行为几乎变得常态化时，她说反复发生的案件应该促使人们认真质疑现有儿童保护系统的有效性。“这不应该令人震惊，但如果你不断听到这些事情一次又一次发生，你就会知道我们正在一个没有系统或一个非常、非常破碎的系统中运作，”她说。她表示，这些指控并非孤立事件，并指出之前媒体对其他中学涉及女学生的虐待进行的调查和报告。“Joy FM，你们做过其他调查；其他报告也出来了，涉及其他中学的女生以及发生的事情。那些案件都怎么样了？”她问道。她认为，此类案件的反复发生引发了人们对当局是否从以往事件中吸取教训并采取有效措施防止类似虐待的担忧。德瓦梅娜-阿博阿吉女士说，这种情况反映了一个更广泛的社会问题，即儿童的经历，特别是报告性虐待的女孩的经历，常常被忽视。她将此描述为社会和司法系统中性暴力的隐形化，认为儿童的关切经常被本应保护他们的成年人忽视。“这只是告诉我一些关于我们心态的事情。我甚至不会说文化或心态。它将是现代性与文化的结合，”她说。她补充说，未能认真对待指控可能会让受害者无法获得正义，并允许虐待继续下去。然而，ARK基金会执行主任强调，被指控者必须在被证明有罪之前被推定无罪。“这是一个案件，如果指控被证明，是的，我们都知道一个人在被证明有罪之前是被推定无罪的，我们需要提醒自己这一点，”她说。尽管有这一法律原则，她敦促当局以应有的严肃态度对待这些指控，并调查案件周围的情况。她说，该国需要超越表达关切，并采取具体步骤确保学校不容忍性虐待。德瓦梅娜-阿博阿吉女士呼吁查明并惩罚任何可能帮助或隐瞒所谓虐待行为的人，并表示问责应超出被指控者本人。“所有共谋者必须在各个层面被查明并受到制裁，”她说。她表示，结束有罪不罚对于防止进一步的性暴力案件并确保责任人不能依靠其职位或关系逃避问责至关重要。“第一件事是有罪不罚必须结束。我们必须让人们明白，你不能把我们对性暴力视而不见的心态带入一个正在发生的真实案件中。我们需要采取行动，”她说。ARK基金会执行主任说，社会福利部本应查明所谓受害者，包括那些可能已返回家乡社区的人，并确保他们获得心理社会支持。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/b.body: BUA Foods Plc has introduced a new product targeting the everyday operational and commercial needs of Nigerian bakers, as the company seeks to deepen its presence in the flour market. Unveiled at a trade launch in Kano over the weekend, Bakers Pride Flour, is positioned around affordability of choice, dependable baking performance and versatility across different baking applications, including gurasa, the popular Northern Nigerian flatbread, conventional bread and other baked goods. Speaking at the event, Managing Director of BUA Foods, Mr. Ayodele Abioye, said the new brand was developed with a view to supporting bakers’ growth and strengthening the company’s relationship with operators across the baking value chain. Flour remains a critical input for bakeries, where product consistency and input costs can influence production decisions, finished-product quality and business returns. He said the product was designed to deliver consistent quality and reliable performance, adding that the company recognised the importance of bakers to the wider food production and distribution chain. Abioye said, “Today, we are not merely launching another product. We are opening a new chapter of opportunity—for greater consistency, stronger productivity, better value, and even greater pride in every product that leaves the oven. “Bakers pride flour was designed based on an understanding of the realities of Nigerian bakers and carries a simple promise in every bag: reliable performance, consistent quality, and confidence in every bake.” He added that the company’s understanding of the practical challenges facing Nigerian bakers informed the product’s development, with the aim of giving them greater confidence in their baking operations. Pride Flour is built around three propositions: Smart Choice, Dependable Baking and More Possibilities. The company said the product’s versatility was intended to give bakers options across multiple applications, from traditional regional staples to mainstream bakery products, potentially enabling them to cater to different customer preferences. General Manager, Brand and Corporate Communications, Adewunmi Desalu, said baking required operators to balance product quality with the commercial demands of running a business. She said, “Baking is both a skill and a business. Bakers need to consider the quality of their finished products alongside the commercial realities of running their businesses. Bakers Pride Flour is designed to offer a relevant choice for these everyday needs.” Desalu said the company hoped to establish the product as an option for bread production and other baking applications. Beyond the product itself, BUA Foods is also relying on its trade network to build market access and secure distribution for the new brand. General Manager, Sales, Alim Liman, said distributors, wholesalers and retailers would be central to ensuring that Bakers Pride Flour reached its target markets and remained available to customers. According to him, the company would work with its trade partners to expand distribution, improve market availability and create value throughout the supply chain. He said, “Our distributors, wholesalers and retailers are critical partners in our success. Introducing a new product is only the first step; ensuring that it reaches the right markets, remains available to customers and earns a place in their businesses requires a shared commitment. We look forward to working closely with our partners to build distribution, strengthen market availability and create value across the trade.” The launch event brought together trade partners, bakers and other industry stakeholders to familiarise them with the product and its commercial proposition. The introduction of bakers pride represented another addition to its product portfolio, with the company seeking to align its offerings with the needs of bakers while strengthening engagement with distribution partners.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/b.title_zh: BUA Foods通过新产品线深化面粉市场渗透，提升面包师盈利能力
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/b.body_zh: BUA Foods Plc推出了一款新产品，针对尼日利亚面包师日常运营和商业需求，该公司正寻求深化其在面粉市场的存在。该产品于周末在卡诺举行的贸易发布会上亮相，Bakers Pride Flour定位于选择的 affordability、可靠的烘焙性能以及在不同烘焙应用中的多功能性，包括gurasa（受欢迎的尼日利亚北部扁面包）、传统面包和其他烘焙食品。在活动上发言时，BUA Foods总经理Ayodele Abioye先生表示，新品牌是着眼于支持面包师的增长并加强公司与烘焙价值链各运营商的关系而开发的。面粉仍然是面包店的关键投入品，产品一致性和投入成本会影响生产决策、成品质量和业务回报。他说，该产品旨在提供一致的质量和可靠的性能，并补充说公司认识到面包师对更广泛的食品生产和分销链的重要性。Abioye说，“今天，我们不仅仅是在推出另一个产品。我们正在开启一个新的机会篇章——为了更大的 一致性、更强的生产力、更好的价值，甚至在每个从烤箱中出来的产品中都有更大的自豪感。”“Bakers Pride Flour是基于对尼日利亚面包师现实的理解而设计的，每袋都带着一个简单的承诺：可靠的性能、一致的质量，以及每次烘焙的信心。”他补充说，公司对尼日利亚面包师面临的实际挑战的理解指导了该产品的开发，目的是让他们对自己的烘焙操作更有信心。Pride Flour围绕三个主张构建：Smart Choice、Dependable Baking和More Possibilities。该公司表示，该产品的多功能性旨在为面包师提供跨越多种应用的选择，从传统区域主食到主流面包店产品，可能使他们能够迎合不同的客户偏好。品牌和企业传播总经理Adewunmi Desalu表示，烘焙要求运营商在产品质量与经营企业的商业需求之间取得平衡。她说，“烘焙既是一项技能，也是一项业务。面包师需要考虑他们成品的质量，同时考虑经营企业的商业现实。Bakers Pride Flour旨在为这些日常需求提供一个相关的选择。”Desalu表示，公司希望将该产品确立为面包生产和其他烘焙应用的选择。除了产品本身之外，BUA Foods还依赖其贸易网络来建立市场准入并确保新品牌的配送。销售总经理Alim Liman表示，分销商、批发商和零售商将是确保Bakers Pride Flour到达其目标市场并保持对客户可用性的核心。据他介绍，公司将与其贸易伙伴合作扩大配送、改善市场可用性并在整个供应链中创造价值。他说，“我们的分销商、批发商和零售商是我们成功的关键伙伴。推出新产品只是第一步；确保它到达正确的市场、保持对客户的可用性并在他们的业务中赢得一席之地需要共同的承诺。我们期待与我们的伙伴密切合作，以建立配送、加强市场可用性并在贸易中创造价值。”发布会聚集了贸易伙伴、面包师和其他行业利益相关者，让他们熟悉该产品及其商业主张。bakers pride的推出代表着对其产品组合的又一补充，该公司寻求将其产品与面包师的需求保持一致，同时加强与分销伙伴的互动。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/k.body: No fewer than 400 vulnerable persons in Rafin Zuru Ward of Zuru Local Government Area of Kebbi State have benefited from a financial empowerment programme initiated by the Special Adviser on Communication and Strategy to Governor Nasir Idris, Abdullahi Idris Sadaukin Zuru. The beneficiaries, comprising aged men and women, widows, youths and women traders, each received between N10,000 and N20,000 under the “Sadaukin Zuru Empowerment Initiative for the Needy” to meet basic needs and boost small business capital. The empowerment, held at the weekend in Zuru, was aimed at cushioning the current economic challenges and supporting low-income earners to sustain their livelihoods and improve household income. Speaking at the event, Sadaukin Zuru said the initiative was inspired by the leadership style of Governor Nasir Idris, whom he described as a model of compassion and generosity. He thanked Governor Idris for the opportunity to serve in his administration and for encouraging political appointees to give back to their communities. He also commended the Commissioner for Agriculture, Alhaji Shehu Muazu Haruna, for his support towards the success of the programme. Speaking on behalf of stakeholders of Zuru Emirate, a member of the Kebbi State Executive Committee, Alhaji Muhammad Maikudi Saleh, said the Governor’s investment in infrastructure, education, healthcare and agriculture has inspired others to emulate him. Saleh said the empowerment programme was a practical demonstration of the All Progressives Congress (APC) government’s commitment to inclusive growth and welfare of the people. He urged beneficiaries to use the cash support judiciously to expand their businesses and improve their living conditions, stressing that empowerment remains key to poverty reduction. The event, which attracted politicians, Kauran Gwandu support groups, market women, youth organisations, students and associates from Niger, Sokoto and Zamfara States, ended with stakeholders reaffirming their support for President Bola Ahmed Tinubu and Governor Idris for continuity in 2027. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/k.body_zh: 凯比州祖鲁地方政府区祖鲁祖鲁区的拉芬祖鲁病房不少于400名弱势人员受益于州长纳西尔·伊德里斯通讯与战略特别顾问阿卜杜拉希·伊德里斯·萨道金·祖鲁发起的一项金融赋权计划。受益者包括老年男性和女性、寡妇、青年和女性商人，每人根据“萨道金·祖鲁贫困者赋权倡议”获得1万至2万奈拉不等的资金，以满足基本需求并增加小企业资本。该赋权活动于周末在祖鲁举行，旨在缓解当前经济挑战，支持低收入者维持生计并提高家庭收入。在活动中发言时，萨道金·祖鲁表示，该倡议的灵感来自州长纳西尔·伊德里斯的管理风格，他将其描述为同情和慷慨的典范。他感谢州长伊德里斯为他提供在其政府中服务的机会，并鼓励政治任命者回馈他们的社区。他还赞扬农业专员阿尔哈吉·谢胡·穆阿祖·哈鲁纳对该计划成功提供的支持。代表祖鲁酋长国利益相关者发言的凯比州执行委员会成员阿尔哈吉·穆罕默德·迈库迪·萨利赫表示，州长在基础设施、教育、医疗保健和农业方面的投资激励了其他人效仿他。萨利赫说，该赋权计划是全体进步大会（APC）政府致力于包容性增长和人民福祉的实际体现。他敦促受益者明智地使用现金支持来扩大他们的业务并改善他们的生活条件，并强调赋权仍然是减少贫困的关键。该活动吸引了政界人士、考兰·格万杜支持团体、市场妇女、青年组织、来自尼日尔州、索科托州和扎姆法拉州的学生和伙伴，以利益相关者重申支持总统博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布和州长伊德里斯在2027年继续执政而结束。THISDAY成立于1995年1月22日，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕克里克路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都区和世界各地设有办事处。它是尼日利亚最具权威性的新闻媒体，在所有平台上为政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶级提供服务，同时作为新思想、文化和技术与有抱负者和千禧一代的交汇点。该报纸是一种公共信托，致力于追求真理和理性，涵盖从突发新闻到政治、商业、市场、艺术、体育和社区以及人与社会交汇点的一系列问题。您可以通过hello@thisdaylive.com与我们联系或访问我们的联系页面。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/e.body: The National Chairman of the All Progressives Congress (APC), Prof. Nentawe Yilwatda has charged the Directorate of Intelligence and Security of the APC Presidential Campaign Council (APC-PCC) to ensure the safety of members during the electioneering campaigns. Yilwatda who was represented by the Deputy National Secretary of the party, Prof. Abdulkarim Kana gave the charge on Monday in Abuja during the inauguration of the committee. He noted that the subcommittee is the first to convene a meeting and set up its operational substructures ahead of the main campaign council. The chairman noted: “This committee, I think, is the most hero-studded committee of all the committees. And you’ve proven yourselves to be most serious. “It is the first committee to convene this kind of meeting, a gathering in operation of the substructures of the main committee of the campaign council. I think it’s a huge clap for yourselves.” Yilwatda commended members for self-organising even before funding allocations were made to directorates. “Even before the finance committee started to think of how much to allocate to the directorates, you organized yourselves. I must commend you,” he said. The chairman charged the subcommittee on its critical role as campaigns commence, noting that the election is a few days away. He added: “Before we leave, you must ensure that the venue is safe and secure. When we are there, you must ensure that we are safe and protected. When we need to go and come back, you must ensure that the paths and roads are also secure. “So this is the purpose of your committee. It is a committee that will be there ahead of us. It will be there while we are there. It will also be there after we leave.” Also, Director, Intelligence and Security, Gen. Sarkin Bello (rtd) described the assignment as a national exercise that demands discipline, sound judgement and commitment to the safety of the principal and the integrity of the democratic process. “Our responsibility is to ensure that the campaign communicates the President’s record, priorities and vision accurately with dignity and with respect to the Nigerian electorate,” Bello said. He noted that a nationwide presidential campaign involves extensive travels, large gatherings and rapidly changing circumstances, requiring alertness without alarmism. “We must remain conscious of risks associated with public gatherings, crowd management, misinformation, criminal activity and communal tensions,” he said. On his part, Minister of Defence and Secretary of the Directorate, Gen. Christopher Musa said security is paramount to the success of the campaign, noting that the opposition will use economy and insecurity as campaign issues. He said the return of the President is assured but the Directorate must provide the enabling environment, ensure peaceful campaigns, and work with the Information Directorate to project the President’s achievements, especially against misinformation on social media. “Working as a team is the most critical aspect for us, because if we’re divided, we can’t achieve anything,” Musa said. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/e.title_zh: 确保我们在竞选期间的安全，Yilwatda要求APC情报和安全委员会
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/e.body_zh: 全进步大会党（APC）全国主席恩塔韦·伊尔瓦特达教授责成APC总统竞选委员会情报与安全局确保成员在竞选活动期间的安全。伊尔瓦特达由该党副全国书记阿卜杜勒卡里姆·卡纳教授代表，于周一在阿布贾举行的该委员会就职典礼上作出这一指示。他指出，该小组委员会是第一个召开会议并在主要竞选委员会之前建立其运作子结构的小组委员会。主席指出：“我认为，这个委员会是所有委员会中明星最多、最耀眼的委员会。你们已经证明自己是最认真的。“这是第一个召开此类会议的委员会，是竞选委员会主要委员会子结构运作的集会。我认为，这值得为自己热烈鼓掌。”伊尔瓦特达赞扬成员们甚至在向各局拨付资金之前就进行了自我组织。“甚至在财务委员会开始考虑向各局分配多少钱之前，你们就自己组织起来了。我必须表扬你们，”他说。主席责成该小组委员会在竞选开始时发挥关键作用，并指出选举还有几天就要举行。他补充说：“在我们离开之前，你们必须确保场地安全可靠。当我们在那里时，你们必须确保我们安全并受到保护。当我们需要去和回来时，你们必须确保路径和道路也安全。“所以这就是你们委员会的目的。这是一个会先于我们到达的委员会。它会在我们在那里时也在那里。它也会在我们离开后还在那里。”此外，情报与安全局局长萨尔金·贝洛将军（退役）将这项任务描述为一项需要纪律、良好判断力和对主要人物安全以及民主进程完整性的承诺的国家行动。“我们的责任是确保竞选准确、有尊严并尊重尼日利亚选民地传达总统的记录、优先事项和愿景，”贝洛说。他指出，全国性的总统竞选涉及广泛的旅行、大型集会和快速变化的环境，需要保持警惕但不制造恐慌。“我们必须始终意识到与公共集会、人群管理、错误信息、犯罪活动和社区紧张局势相关的风险，”他说。就他而言，国防部长兼该局秘书克里斯托弗·穆萨将军表示，安全对于竞选的成功至关重要，并指出反对派将利用经济和不安全作为竞选议题。他说总统的回归是有保证的，但该局必须提供有利的环境，确保和平竞选，并与信息局合作宣传总统的成就，特别是针对社交媒体上的错误信息。“作为一个团队工作对我们来说是最关键的方面，因为如果我们分裂，我们就无法取得任何成就，”穆萨说。THISDAY 成立于 1995 年 1 月 22 日，由 THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD. 出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕克里克路 35 号，在尼日利亚 36 个州、联邦首都特区和世界各地设有办事处。它是尼日利亚最具权威性的新闻媒体，可在所有平台上为政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶级提供服务，同时作为新思想、文化和技术与有抱负者和千禧一代的交汇点。该报纸是一种公共信托，致力于追求真理和理性，涵盖从突发新闻到政治、商业、市场、艺术、体育和社区以及人与社会交汇点的一系列问题。您可以通过 hello@thisdaylive.com 给我们发邮件或访问我们的联系页面

https://www.myjoyonline.com/vice-preside.title: Vice-President calls for Chinese investment in local processing of Ghana’s raw materials
https://www.myjoyonline.com/vice-preside.summary: Vice-President Professor Naana Jane Opoku-Agyemang has urged Chinese investors to invest in Ghana’s local processing and manufacturing industries as part of efforts to accelerate industrialisation, create jobs and derive greater economic value from the country’s natural resources.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/vice-preside.summary_zh: 副总统纳安娜·简·奥波库-阿吉曼教授敦促中国投资者投资加纳本地加工和制造业，以此作为加速工业化、创造就业机会并从国家自然资源中获得更大经济价值的努力的一部分。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/vice-preside.body: Vice-President Professor Naana Jane Opoku-Agyemang has urged Chinese investors to invest in Ghana’s local processing and manufacturing industries as part of efforts to accelerate industrialisation, create jobs and derive greater economic value from the country’s natural resources. Speaking to Chinese business executives in Shanghai, she outlined investment opportunities in cocoa, shea nuts, cashew nuts, coconut, timber and other raw materials, encouraging investors to support the production of finished and semi-finished goods from these commodities. She emphasised that Ghana needed to reduce its reliance on raw material exports by building a strong manufacturing sector that could generate employment, enhance productivity and retain a greater proportion of economic value within the country. Professor Opoku-Agyemang pointed to timber processing as an area with significant potential, explaining that Ghana could secure better returns by producing furniture and other finished wood products instead of exporting logs. She said greater investment in domestic processing would strengthen industrial development while providing sustainable employment opportunities for the country’s growing population. The Vice-President further highlighted the importance of ensuring that technical and vocational education and training meets the needs of industry, enabling young people to acquire skills that correspond with available employment opportunities. “Training people for jobs that do not exist is training them for unemployment,” she said. She explained that investment in productive sectors was necessary to create opportunities for technically trained young people to put their skills to use and contribute to national development. She cautioned that a lack of adequate employment opportunities could leave increasing numbers of trained young people frustrated. Professor Opoku-Agyemang reiterated Ghana’s willingness to work with Chinese businesses through mutually beneficial partnerships, particularly in manufacturing, logistics and other productive areas that could contribute to sustainable economic growth. She also drew attention to the opportunities available through the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA), which provides a framework for increasing trade across Africa. According to her, Ghana’s strategic location as a gateway to the wider African market presents an opportunity for Chinese investors to establish businesses that can reach customers across the continent. She nevertheless stressed that partnerships between Ghana and China should produce practical benefits for both countries, including employment creation, increased productive capacity and improved opportunities for Ghanaian businesses. The Vice-President also questioned the extent of Ghanaian traders’ participation in businesses associated with China, raising concerns about the opportunities available to them in the Chinese market. In particular, she questioned whether Ghanaian traders could obtain ownership stakes in the businesses they support. Her concerns highlighted the need for stronger participation by Ghanaian entrepreneurs in international trade and investment, ensuring that economic cooperation between the two countries provides opportunities for local businesses to benefit more directly. The discussions form part of Ghana’s wider efforts to strengthen economic relations with China and attract investment into industries capable of adding value to the country’s raw materials. Ghana produces commodities including cocoa, cashew nuts, shea and timber, alongside mineral resources such as bauxite, lithium and diamonds. Increasing investment in domestic processing and manufacturing could help create employment, develop local industries, reduce dependence on raw material exports and ensure that a larger share of the value generated from these resources remains in Ghana.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/vice-preside.title_zh: 副总统呼吁中国投资加纳原材料的本地加工
https://www.myjoyonline.com/vice-preside.body_zh: 副总统纳安娜·简·奥波库-阿吉曼教授敦促中国投资者投资加纳本地加工和制造业，以此作为加速工业化、创造就业机会并从国家自然资源中获取更大经济价值的努力的一部分。她在上海对中国企业高管讲话时，概述了可可、乳木果、腰果、椰子、木材和其他原材料的投资机会，鼓励投资者支持用这些商品生产成品和半成品。她强调，加纳需要通过建立强大的制造业来减少对原材料出口的依赖，该制造业能够创造就业、提高生产力并在国内保留更大比例的经济价值。奥波库-阿吉曼教授指出木材加工是一个具有巨大潜力的领域，她解释说，加纳可以通过生产家具和其他成品木制品而不是出口原木来获得更好的回报。她表示，对国内加工的更大投资将加强工业发展，同时为国家不断增长的人口提供可持续的就业机会。副总统进一步强调，确保技术和职业教育与培训满足行业需求的重要性，这能让年轻人获得与现有就业机会相匹配的技能。“为不存在的工作培训人们就是培训他们失业，”她说。她解释说，对生产性部门的投资对于为受过技术培训的年轻人创造机会来运用他们的技能并为国家发展做出贡献是必要的。她警告说，缺乏足够的就业机会可能会让越来越多受过培训的年轻人感到沮丧。奥波库-阿吉曼教授重申了加纳愿意通过互利伙伴关系与中国企业合作，特别是在制造业、物流和其他能够促进可持续经济增长的生产性领域。她还提请注意通过非洲大陆自由贸易区（AfCFTA）提供的机会，该自贸区为增加非洲内部贸易提供了框架。据她介绍，加纳作为通往更广阔非洲市场的门户的战略位置为中国投资者提供了一个机会，可以建立能够触及整个非洲大陆客户的企业。尽管如此，她强调，加纳和中国之间的伙伴关系应该为两国带来实际利益，包括创造就业、提高生产能力和改善加纳企业的机会。副总统还质疑加纳贸易商参与与中国相关业务的程度，对他们在中国的市场中可获得的机会表示担忧。她特别质疑加纳贸易商是否能够获得他们所支持企业的所有权股份。她的担忧突显了加纳企业家需要更强地参与国际贸易和投资，确保两国之间的经济合作能为本地企业提供更直接的受益机会。这些讨论是加纳加强与中国经济关系并吸引投资进入能够为国家原材料增加价值的产业的更广泛努力的一部分。加纳生产包括可可、腰果、乳木果和木材在内的商品，以及铝土矿、锂和钻石等矿产资源。增加对国内加工和制造业的投资可以帮助创造就业、发展本地产业、减少对原材料出口的依赖，并确保这些资源产生的更大份额的价值留在加纳。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/p.summary: In other words, the Nigerian Constitution recognizes Nigeria as a federation with three tiers of government—federal, state and local. The first comes from Tinubu’s ideological attachment, to the task of restructuring the Nigerian governance system even before becoming the president, and even as he was never in the habit of playing to the gallery about it.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/p.summary_zh: 换言之，尼日利亚宪法承认尼日利亚是一个拥有三级政府——联邦、州和地方的联邦制国家。第一点来自蒂努布的意识形态依附，即在成为总统之前甚至就致力于重组尼日利亚治理体系的任务，即使他从来没有习惯于对此哗众取宠。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/p.body: One of the fundamental diagnoses of the Nigerian state is that its constitutional framework for governance is at variance with its plural reality. In other words, the Nigerian Constitution recognizes Nigeria as a federation with three tiers of government—federal, state and local. Unfortunately, the structural and institutional mechanisms of governance are so centralized and seemingly unitary in ways that deny the realities for all practical purpose. This is one key anomaly that explains why the local government structure has remained comatose since the Ironsi administration. It also explains one of the crucial reasons why the democratic governance since 1999 has not really translated into a decisively significant positive and hence impactful package of democratic dividends especially in terms of local governance at the grassroots. And this makes the challenge of restructuring the Nigerian constitution to achieve the essence of a genuine federation all the more cogent for any administration willing to make sense of the Nigerian predicament and find adequate resolution that unburden developmental and governance targets on behalf of millions of Nigerians. This agenda is most significant for the Tinubu administration for two fundamental reasons. The first comes from Tinubu’s ideological attachment, to the task of restructuring the Nigerian governance system even before becoming the president, and even as he was never in the habit of playing to the gallery about it. One of the rallying points of his connection with the progressive elements in the Nigerian state is the imperative of constitutional restructuring of the Nigerian federation. The second reason derives from some of his key governance policies since assuming the position of the president of the federal republic of Nigeria. A few examples of significant governance policies have been enacted that seem to signal that the administration has come to terms with the necessity of restructuring as a pathway to impactful governance reform. One significant policy is the creation of the Ministry of Regional Development that is meant to instigate socioeconomic and infrastructural progress across the six geopolitical zones in Nigeria. The ministry makes it possible to measure policy convergences and divergence across these zones in ways that facilitate harmonization. This policy is followed by a correlative one: the establishment of six regional development commissions (RDCs) that would serve as the arrowhead of the policy initiatives, formulation and design. Next in line, and beyond all expectations of its possibility, the Tinubu government has pushed the bill legislating the creation of state police closer to realization. Signing the 2023 Electricity Act significantly decentralized electricity generation, transmission and distribution away from the exclusive to the concurrent list, a policy which enables state to take charge of power generation. There are three separate amendments ongoing to the Nigerian Minerals and Mining Act 2007 which are meant to undermine its rigid centralization of the ownership of solid minerals and other natural endowments in the hand of the federal government to the exclusion of the other tiers of government. Fundamental to all these sweeping legislative overhaul and policy transformation, and coterminous with the Supreme Court ruling of July 2024 concerning the financial autonomy of local governments, is the urgency of incentivizing the subnational elements and entities in the Nigerian federation to commence the project of actively investing in their own regions and achieve governance distinction. All these speak to the challenge of restructuring to unlock the governance potentials inherent in laying the foundation for a true federalism in Nigeria.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/p.title_zh: 总统蒂努布与重组联邦的未竟事业
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/p.body_zh: 尼日利亚国家的一个基本诊断是，其治理宪法框架与其多元现实不一致。换言之，尼日利亚宪法承认尼日利亚是一个拥有三级政府——联邦、州和地方——的联邦制国家。不幸的是，治理的结构和制度机制是如此集中且看似单一，以至于在所有实际目的上都否认了这些现实。这是解释为什么自伊龙西政府以来地方政府结构一直处于昏迷状态的一个关键异常。这也解释了为什么自1999年以来的民主治理并没有真正转化为决定性显著积极并因此具有影响力的民主红利包，尤其是在基层地方治理方面。这使得重组尼日利亚宪法以实现真正联邦制本质的挑战，对于任何愿意理解尼日利亚困境并找到充分解决方案以减轻数百万尼日利亚人的发展和治理目标的政府而言，变得更加有说服力。这一议程对蒂努布政府而言最为重要，原因有两个基本理由。第一个来自蒂努布在成为总统之前就对重组尼日利亚治理体系的任务有着意识形态上的依恋，即使他从未习惯于对此哗众取宠。他与尼日利亚国家进步人士联系的集结点之一就是尼日利亚联邦宪法重组的必要性。第二个理由源于他自担任尼日利亚联邦共和国总统以来的一些关键治理政策。已经颁布了一些重要治理政策的例子，似乎表明本届政府已经接受了重组作为实现有影响力的治理改革的途径。一个重要政策是设立区域发展部，该部旨在推动尼日利亚六个地缘政治区跨越的社会经济和基础设施进步。该部使衡量这些地区之间的政策趋同和分歧成为可能，从而促进协调。这一政策之后是一个相关的政策：设立六个区域发展委员会（RDCs），这些委员会将作为政策倡议、制定和设计的先锋。接下来，超出其可能性的所有预期，蒂努布政府已将立法设立州警察的法案推向实现。签署2023年电力法显著地将电力生产、传输和分配从专属清单分散到并存清单，这一政策使州能够负责电力生产。目前正在对2007年尼日利亚矿产和采矿法进行三项单独的修正案，这些修正案旨在削弱其对固体矿产和其他自然禀赋所有权的严格集中，将其置于联邦政府手中而排除其他各级政府。在所有这些全面的立法改革和政策转变中，与2024年7月最高法院关于地方政府财政自治的裁决同时发生的是，迫切需要激励尼日利亚联邦中的次国家元素和实体开始积极投资于它们自己的地区并实现治理卓越。所有这些都指向重组的挑战，以释放固有的治理潜力，为在尼日利亚奠定真正联邦制的基础。

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary: The governorship candidate of the Social Democratic Party (SDP) in Nasarawa State, Muhammad Adamu, has called on security agencies to investigate the killing of his coordinator in Alagye Electoral Ward, Doma Local Government Area by suspected kidnappers. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary_zh: 纳萨拉瓦州社会民主党（SDP）州长候选人穆罕默德·阿达穆呼吁安全机构调查他的协调员在多马地方政府区阿拉吉选举区被疑似绑架者杀害的事件。他的遇害也引起了纳萨拉瓦州学生协会（NASSA）全国主席丹拉迪·埃克波的反应，他确认死者是他的表亲，通常被称为Young Money。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: The governorship candidate of the Social Democratic Party (SDP) in Nasarawa State, Muhammad Adamu, has called on security agencies to investigate the killing of his coordinator in Alagye Electoral Ward, Doma Local Government Area by suspected kidnappers. The body of Baba Alhaji has been found, according to a condolence message posted by Mr Adamu, a retired inspector-general of police, on his official Facebook page. His killing has also drawn a reaction from Danladi Ekpo, the national president of the Nasarawa State Students Association (NASSA), who identified the deceased as his cousin, popularly known as Young Money. “Today he is a victim of circumstances, a victim of kidnapping. My brother died in the hands of kidnappers. Nigeria failed him, Nasarawa State failed him, Doma failed him, Alagye failed him,” he said. Mr Ekpo described his cousin as a dependable relative who supported him, particularly during his election as NASSA national president. “Baban Alhaji was a cousin who looked after me as though there was no tomorrow. His constant visits, his check-ups, and his support, especially during my election, will never be forgotten,” he said. He described the death as a painful loss and prayed for the repose of his cousin’s soul. In his condolence message, Mr Adamu said the killing was a loss to his political family, the deceased’s relatives and the wider community. “This painful incident is a great loss to our political family, his loved ones, and the entire community. No words can adequately express the grief we feel over this unfortunate development,” he said. The SDP candidate extended his condolences to the deceased’s family, friends, associates and members of his support group. He also prayed that Allah forgives the deceased’s shortcomings and grants him Aljannatul Firdaus. Mr Adamu called on security agencies to investigate the incident, identify those responsible and bring them to justice. PREMIUM TIMES contacted Ramhan Nansel, the police public relations officer in Nasarawa State, for a response. He had not responded at the time of filing this report. The circumstances surrounding the abduction and killing, including the identities of those responsible, remain unclear
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: Nasarawa SDP协调员在Doma被绑架后遇害
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 纳萨拉瓦州社会民主党（SDP）州长候选人穆罕默德·亚当努呼吁安全机构调查其在多马地方政府区阿拉吉选举区协调员疑似被绑架者杀害的事件。根据亚当努先生（一位退休的警察总监）在其官方Facebook页面发布的吊唁消息，巴巴·阿尔哈吉的遗体已被找到。他的遇害也引发了纳萨拉瓦州学生协会（NASSA）全国主席丹拉迪·埃克波的反应，后者确认死者是他的堂兄，通常被称为Young Money。“今天他是环境的受害者，是绑架的受害者。我的兄弟死于绑架者之手。尼日利亚辜负了他，纳萨拉瓦州辜负了他，多马辜负了他，阿拉吉辜负了他，”他说。埃克波先生形容他的堂兄是一位可靠的亲属，尤其是在他当选NASSA全国主席期间给予了他支持。“巴巴·阿尔哈吉是一位像对待没有明天一样照顾我的堂兄。他不断的探访、他的检查以及他的支持，尤其是在我选举期间的支持，将永远不会被忘记，”他说。他形容这一死亡是一个痛苦的损失，并为堂兄灵魂的安息祈祷。在他的吊唁消息中，亚当努先生表示，这一杀害事件对他的政治家庭、死者的亲属以及更广泛的社区来说是一个损失。“这一痛苦的事件对我们的政治家庭、他的亲人以及整个社区来说是一个巨大的损失。没有言语能够充分表达我们对这一不幸事态的悲痛，”他说。SDP候选人向死者的家人、朋友、伙伴以及他的支持团体成员表示慰问。他还祈祷安拉宽恕死者的缺点并赐予他Aljannatul Firdaus。亚当努先生呼吁安全机构调查这一事件，找出责任人并将他们绳之以法。PREMIUM TIMES联系了纳萨拉瓦州警察公共关系官员拉姆汉·南塞尔寻求回应。在本报告撰写时，他尚未回应。围绕绑架和杀害的情况，包括责任人的身份，仍不清楚

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.summary_zh: 约瑟夫·萨尔万·塔尔卡大学马库尔迪分校（JOSTUM）副校长艾萨克·伊托多在学生投诉后暂停了2026/2027学年本科生学费拟议的上涨。伊托多先生在其官方Facebook页面发布的一份声明中宣布了这一决定，表示他听取了学生的关切并咨询了相关大学监管机构后决定停止上涨。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.body: The Vice-Chancellor of Joseph Sarwuan Tarka University, Makurdi (JOSTUM), Isaac Itodo, has suspended a proposed increase in undergraduate fees for the 2026/2027 academic session after students complained. Mr Itodo announced the decision in a statement published on his official Facebook page, saying he had listened to students’ concerns and consulted relevant university regulatory bodies before deciding to halt the increase. “Undergraduate school fees for the 2026/2027 academic session will remain unchanged,” he said. The announcement comes as the university resumed for the new academic session on Monday, amid concerns over revised charges for some services and the approved academic calendar. In a separate advisory, the Deputy Vice-Chancellor (Academic), Raymond Wuana, said the university had reviewed charges for online screening and admission acceptance, health services, hostel accommodation and postgraduate programmes. He stressed that the review did not include undergraduate school fees, which he said had not been increased. “The review concerns only specified services and postgraduate charges,” Mr Wuana said in the advisory addressed to students. He explained that the university was facing rising operational costs, increasing student enrolment and a limited internally generated revenue base, making it necessary to review some charges to sustain essential services and infrastructure. Mr Wuana urged students with concerns to use established university channels to communicate with management. “My dear children, go where? My responsibilities take me across the South Core, Middle Core and North Core of this campus to ensure that our University continues to develop and that you receive quality education,” he said. He added that students had the right to question decisions and express their concerns but should do so responsibly. “Criticism is welcome; violence, intimidation and actions that threaten our University’s peace and reputation are not,” he said, urging students not to allow themselves to be used to disrupt academic activities. Mr Wuana also cautioned against insults, confrontational conduct and inflammatory statements directed at university management, urging student representatives to present their concerns formally and offer practical recommendations. The university also defended its approved academic calendar, which provides for resumption on 19 October and an eight-week mid-semester break beginning in mid-December 2026 and extending until after the 2027 general elections. Mr Wuana said the calendar had been approved by the University Senate and was designed to address transport, security and movement concerns while ensuring the orderly conduct of academic activities. Mr Itodo said the decision to resume promptly was intended to recover academic time lost to strikes and other delays and ensure the session progressed sufficiently before the 2027 elections. Both officials urged students to resume, complete their registration and attend lectures, while encouraging dialogue between students and management. Mr Itodo said the university remained committed to improving education and managing its resources prudently, adding that undergraduate school fees would remain unchanged for the session

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.body_zh: 约瑟夫·萨尔万·塔尔卡大学（JOSTUM）副校长艾萨克·伊托多在学生投诉后，暂停了2026/2027学年本科生学费拟议的上涨。伊托多先生在其官方Facebook页面发布的声明中宣布了这一决定，称他在听取了学生的担忧并咨询了大学相关监管机构后，决定停止上涨。他说：“2026/2027学年的本科生学费将保持不变。”这一宣布是在大学于周一恢复新学期的同时发布的，当时人们对某些服务修订收费和批准的学术日历表示担忧。在另一份咨询中，主管学术的副校长雷蒙德·吴阿纳表示，大学已审查了在线筛选和录取接受、健康服务、宿舍住宿以及研究生项目的收费。他强调审查不包括本科生学费，他说本科生学费没有增加。“审查仅涉及指定的服务和研究生收费，”吴阿纳先生在给学生的咨询中说。他解释说，大学面临着不断上升的运营成本、越来越多的学生入学以及内部创收基础有限，因此有必要审查一些收费以维持基本服务和基础设施。吴阿纳先生敦促有担忧的学生通过既定的大学渠道与管理层沟通。他说：“我亲爱的孩子们，去哪里？我的职责带我穿越这个校园的南核心、中核心和北核心，以确保我们的大学继续发展，并让你们接受优质教育。”他补充说，学生有权质疑决定并表达他们的担忧，但应该负责任地这样做。他说：“欢迎批评；暴力、恐吓以及威胁我们大学和平与声誉的行为则不受欢迎。”他敦促学生不要让自己被利用来破坏学术活动。吴阿纳先生还警告不要对大学管理层进行侮辱、对抗行为和煽动性言论，敦促学生代表正式提出他们的担忧并提供切实可行的建议。大学还为其批准的学术日历进行了辩护，该日历规定于10月19日复课，并从2026年12月中旬开始为期八周的学期中期休息，一直持续到2027年大选之后。吴阿纳先生说，该日历已由大学评议会批准，旨在解决交通、安全和流动问题，同时确保学术活动的有序进行。伊托多先生说，及时复课的决定旨在弥补因罢工和其他延误而损失的学术时间，并确保在2027年选举之前充分推进学期。两位官员都敦促学生复课，完成注册并参加讲座，同时鼓励学生和管理层之间进行对话。伊托多先生说，大学仍然致力于改善教育并谨慎管理其资源，并补充说本科生学费在本学期将保持不变。

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: Eight members of the Zamfara State House of Assembly who recently resigned from the All Progressives Congress (APC) have announced their return to the party. This development followed a meeting with President Bola Tinubu at the Presidential Villa in Abuja. The legislators were led to the meeting by the Minister of State for Defence, Bello Matawalle, alongside Aminu Jaji, who represents the Kaura Namoda/Birnin Magaji Federal Constituency in the House of Representatives. The lawmakers are Aliyu Kagara (Talata Mafara South), Ibrahim Tukur (Bakura), Faruk Dosara (Maradun I), Bashir Masama (Bukkuyum North), Muktaru Kaura (Kaura North), Nasiru Abdullahi (Maru North), Bashar Bello (Bungudu West), and Bashar Aliyu (Gummi I). They had been widely tipped to defect to the African Democratic Congress (ADC) after announcing their resignation from the APC, citing internal party friction and escalating security challenges in rural Zamfara communities. They also alleged non-payment of certain allowances and entitlements by the assembly. The lawmakers had been embroiled in a protracted power struggle in the State House of Assembly. They were suspended by the Assembly leadership for attempting to remove the Speaker. However, they have now stated that their grievances were being addressed through presidential reconciliation championed by Mr Matawalle. The lawmakers promised to work for the growth of the party and its victory in the 2027 elections. However, one of them, Mr Abdullahi (Maru North), has been screened to contest for the state legislature seat under the ADC. Zamfara is one of Nigeria’s most politically volatile states, currently governed by Dauda Lawal, who defected earlier this year from the PDP, having defeated the sitting APC governor, Mr Matawalle, in the 2023 governorship election. The state APC hierarchy has experienced persistent factional tensions among key party figures, including former governors Mr Matawalle and Abdul’aziz Yari, as well as federal lawmakers like Mr Jaji. President Tinubu’s intervention is seen by political analysts as a critical move to unite the party for the 2027 elections
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: 2027年：八名赞法拉州议员转变立场，在会见蒂努布后准备重返APC
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 最近从全体进步大会党（APC）辞职的赞法拉州议会八名议员宣布重返该党。这一事态发展是在阿布贾总统别墅与总统博拉·蒂努布会面后发生的。这些议员由国防国务部长贝洛·马塔瓦莱率领，与代表众议院考拉·纳莫达/比尔宁·马加吉联邦选区的阿米努·贾吉一同参加会议。议员包括阿里尤·卡加拉（塔拉塔·马法拉南）、易卜拉欣·图库尔（巴库拉）、法鲁克·多萨拉（马拉敦一）、巴希尔·马萨马（布库尤姆北）、穆克塔鲁·考拉（考拉北）、纳西鲁·阿卜杜拉希（马鲁北）、巴沙尔·贝洛（本古杜西）和巴沙尔·阿里尤（古米一）。他们在宣布从APC辞职后，曾被广泛认为将转投非洲民主大会党（ADC），理由是党内摩擦以及赞法拉农村社区安全挑战升级。他们还指控议会未支付某些津贴和应享权利。这些议员曾卷入州议会旷日持久的权力斗争。他们因试图罢免议长而被议会领导层停职。然而，他们现在表示，他们的不满正通过马塔瓦莱先生推动的总统和解得到解决。这些议员承诺为该党的发展和在2027年选举中的胜利而努力。不过，其中一位阿卜杜拉希先生（马鲁北）已接受筛查，将以ADC身份竞选州议会席位。赞法拉是尼日利亚政治最动荡的州之一，目前由达乌达·拉瓦尔执政，他今年早些时候从人民民主党（PDP）转党，在2023年州长选举中击败了时任APC州长马塔瓦莱先生。该州APC领导层在包括前州长马塔瓦莱先生和阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·亚里以及联邦议员如贾吉先生等关键党派人物之间一直存在持续的派系紧张。政治分析人士认为，蒂努布总统的干预是团结该党以备2027年选举的关键举措。
